name: ataxin 2

function.text: ATXN2 encodes ataxin-2. Annotated molecular activities include mRNA binding and epidermal growth factor receptor binding. It participates in P-body assembly and RNA transport.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to spinocerebellar ataxia type 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
